English: We used data from 17 population surveys to estimate age- and sex-specific trends in alcohol consumption in the adult population of South Africa between 1998 and 2016.
Luganda: Twakozesa obubaka okuva mu kunoonyereza 17 okuteebereza enfaanana y’emyaka n’ekikula ky’abantu mu kunywa omwenge mu bantu abakulu mu South Afirika wakati wa 1998 ne 2016.
Yoruba: A lo àwọn dátà láti inú ìtọpinpin àwọn olùgbé 17 láti ṣe ìṣirò ipa ajẹmọ́jọ́-orí àti ẹ̀yà-ìbí nìkan nínú ọtí-líle mímu nínú àwọn olùgbé tí ó jẹ́ àgbà ní orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa láàrin ọdún 1998 àti ọdún 2016.
Zulu: Sisebenzise ulwazi oluvela kuzinhlolovo zabantu eziyi-17 ukuze silinganisele ukujwayeleka kweminyaka yobudala kanye nobulili obuthile ekuphuzweni kotshwala kubantu abadala baseNingizimu Afrika phakathi kowe-1998 nowezi-2016.
Hausa: Mun yi amfani da bayanai daga ƙididdigar yawan jama'a 17 don ƙimanta jinsi da takamaiman shekaru a cikin shaye-shayen barasa da yake faruwa a cikin mutane manya a Afirka ta Kudu a tsakanin shekarar 1998 da kuma shekarar 2016.
Northern Sotho: Re šomišitše tshedimošo go tšwa go dinyakišišo tše 17 tša mabapi le setšhaba go akanya ka ga mekgwa ya go nwa bjala mabapi le batho ba mengwaga le bong bjo itšego ka setšhabeng sa batho ba bagolo ka Afrika Borwa magareng ga 1998 le 2016.
Amharic: በ1998 እና 2016 መካከል ባለው የደቡብ አፍሪካ ጎልማሳ ህዝብ ውስጥ እድሜ- እና ጾታ-ተኮር አዝማሚያዎችን ለመገመት የ17 የህዝብ የዳሰሳ ጥናቶች መረጃን ተጠቅመናል።

English: Independently for each survey, we calculated sex- and age-specific estimates of the prevalence of drinkers and the distribution of individuals across consumption categories.
Luganda: Buli kunoonyereza ng’okutunuulidde kwokka, twabaza ebiteeberezo by’ekikula n’emyaka okulaba obungi bw’abanywi n’obusaasaane bw’abantu kinnoomu mu bibinja by’abanywi.
Yoruba: Ní ìnìkàndúró ìtọpinpin kọ̀ọ̀kan, a ṣẹ ìṣirò ajẹmọ́jọ́-orí àti ẹ̀yà ìbí nìkan ti ìwọ́pọ̀ àwọn tí ó ń mutí àti ipò ẹnìkọ̀ọ̀kan ní àwọn ipele mímu ún.
Zulu: Ngokuzimele kunhlolovo ngayinye, sibale izilinganiso zobulili kanye neminyaka ethile zokuvama kwabaphuzayo kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwabantu kuzo zonke izigaba zokuphuza.
Hausa: Ga kowane bincike shi kaɗai, mun ƙididdige jinsi da takamaiman shekaru game da yawaitar masu shan barasa da rarraba mutane a cikin rukunonin shan barasa.
Northern Sotho: Ka go ikema ka go dinyakišišo tše dingwe le tše dingwe, re ile ra hlakanya dikakanyo tša mabapi le bong le mengwaga ye itšego tša go nwa bjala kudu ga batho le kabaganyo ya batho mabapi le go nwa bkala go ralala le magoro a bao ba nwago bjala.
Amharic: ለእያንዳንዱ የዳሰሳ ጥናት በገለልተኛነት፣ የጠጪዎችን መስፋፋት እና የግለሰቦች በፍጆታ ምድቦች መካከል ያለውን ስርጭት በተመለከተ ጾታ- እና ዕድሜ-ተኮር ግምቶችን አስልተናል።

English: We used these aggregated results, together with data on alcohol production, sales and import/export, as inputs of a Bayesian model and generated yearly estimates of the prevalence of drinkers in the population and the parameters that characterise the distribution of the average consumption among drinkers.
Luganda: Twakozesa ebyazuulibwa ebyo ebibaze, wamu n’obubaka ku kukola omwenge, obutunzi n’okugula omwenge oguyingira/n’ogufuluma ebweru w’eggwanga nga ebyo bye tuteeka mu mutetenkanyirizo gwa Bayesia era tufunamu ebiteeberezo bya buli mwaka okulaba obungi bw’abanywi mu bantu n’ensonga ezinnyonnyola obusaasaane bw’omukkati gw’abunywi mu banywi.
Yoruba: A lo àwọn àkójọpọ̀ àbájáde wọ̀nyìí, papọ̀ mọ́ dátà lórí ìpèsè ọtí-líle, títà àti àgbéwọlé láti ilẹ̀ òkèrè/àgbéjáde lọ sílẹ̀ òkèrè, gẹ́gẹ́ bíi ipa módélì Bésíìnì o sì ń jẹ àwọn ìṣirò ọdọọdún ti ìwọ́pọ̀ àwọn tí ó ń mutí nínú àwọn olùgbé jáde àti àwọn òdiwọ̀n tí ó ń sọ àwọn àbùdá ipò ìṣirò àpapọ̀ mímu rẹ̀ láàrin àwọn tí ó ń mutí.
Zulu: Sisebenzise le miphumela ehlanganisiwe, kanye nolwazi lokukhiqizwa kotshwala, ukuthengisa nokungenisa/ukuthunyelwa kwamanye amazwe, njengokufakwa kwendlela yokwenza yase-Bayesia futhi sakhiqiza izilinganiso zonyaka zokuvama kwabaphuzayo esibalweni sabantu kanye nemingcele ebonisa ukusatshalaliswa kokusetshenziswa okumaphakathi phakathi kwabaphuzayo. .
Hausa: Mun yi amfani da waɗannan jimlar sakamakon, tare da bayanai game da samar da barasa, tallace-tallace da shigo da/fitarwa, a matsayin abubuwan da aka samu na samfurin Bayesian da kuma samar da ƙididdiga na shekara-shekara na yawan masu shan barasa a cikin jama'a da ma'aunai waɗanda suke nuna rarraba matsakaicin shan barasa a tsakanin masu sha.
Northern Sotho: Re šomišitše dipoelo tše di filwego palogare, gotee le Tshedimošo ka ga tšweletšo ya bjala, dithekišo le go bo tsenya ka nageng/le go bo romela dinageng tše dingwe, bjalo ka ditsenyo tša mokgwa wa SeBayesia le go tšweletša dikakanyo tša ngwaga ka ngwaga tša go tlala ga bao ba nwago bjala ka setšhabeng le mathoko a palogare ya go nwa bjala gareng ga bao ba nwago bjala.
Amharic: እነዚህን የተዋሃዱ ውጤቶች፣ ከአልኮል ምርት፣ ሽያጭ እና አስመጪ/ላኪ መረጃዎች ጋር፣ እንደ የቤይስ ሞዴል ግብአቶች እና የመነጩ አመታዊ ግምቶችን በህዝቡ ውስጥ የጠጪዎች መስፋፋት እና በጠጪዎች መካከል አማካይ የፍጆታ ስርጭትን የሚያሳዩ መለኪያዎችን ተጠቅመንባቸዋል።

English: Among males, the prevalence of drinkers decreased between 1998 and 2009, from 56.2% (95% CI : 53.7%;58.7%) to 50.6% (49.3%;52.0%), and increased afterwards to 53.9% (51.5%;56.2%) in 2016.
Luganda: Mu basajja, obungi bw’abanwyi bwakendeera wakati wa 1998 ne 2009, okuva ku 56.2% (95% CI : 53.7%;58.7%) to 50.6% (49.3%;52.0%), ate ne bweyongerea oluvannyuma okutuuka ku 53.9% (51.5%;56.2%) mu 2016.
Yoruba: Láàrin àwọn ọkùnrin, ìwọ́pọ̀ àwọn tí ó ń mutí láàrin ọdún 1998 sí ọdún 2009, láti 56.2% (95% CI : 53.7%;58.7%) sí 50.6% (49.3%;52.0%), tí ó sì ga síi lẹ́yìn gbogbo rẹ̀ sí 53.9% (51.5%;56.2%) ní ọdún 2016.
Zulu: Kwabesilisa, izinga labaphuzayo lehlile phakathi kowe-1998 nowezi-2009, lisuka kuma-56.2% (95% CI : 53.7%;58.7%) laya kuma-50.6% (49.3%;52.0%), ngemva kwalokho lenyuka laya kuma-53.9% (51.5%;56.2%). ) ngowezi-2016.
Hausa: Daga cikin maza, yawan masu shan barasa ya ragu a stsakanin shekarar 1998 da shekarar 2009, daga kashi 56.2% (95% CI: 53.7%;58.7%) zuwa kashi 50.6% (49.3%;52.0%), kuma ya ƙaru daga baya zuwa kashi 53.9% (51.5%;56.2%) ) a cikin shekarar 2016.
Northern Sotho: Gareng ga banna, go tlala ga bao ba nwago bjala go fokotšegile magareng ga 1998 le 2009, go tloga go 56.2% (95% CI : 53.7%;58.7%) to 50.6% (49.3%;52.0%), gomme ba oketšega ka morago ga fao go fihla go 53.9% (51.5%;56.2%) ka 2016.
Amharic: በወንዶች መካከል፣ በ1998 እና 2009 መካከል የጠጪዎች መስፋፋት፣ ከ56.2% (95% CI፡- 53.7%፤58.7%) ወደ 50.6% (49.3%፤52.0%)፣ ቀንሷል እና ከዚያ በኋላ በ2016 ወደ 53.9% (51.5%፤56.2%) ጨምሯል።

Amharic: ለአብዛኞቹ ህመሞች፣ ከፍተኛ ፍጆታ ከፍተኛ ስጋትን ያመጣል።

English: But, the risk increase depends on a person’s sex and age.
Luganda: Wabula, okweyongera kw’obulabe kusinziira ku kikula kya muntu na myaka.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n, ewu yìí ń ní àlékún nípasẹ̀ ọjọ́ orí ènìyàn àti ẹ̀yà-ìbí.
Zulu: Kodwa, ukwanda kwengozi kuncike ebulilini bomuntu kanye neminyaka yobudala.
Hausa: Amma, haɓakar haɗarin ya dogara ne da jinsi da kuma shekarun mutum.
Northern Sotho: Eupša, go oketšega ga kotsi go laolwa ke bong le mengwaga ya motho.
Amharic: ነገር ግን፣ የአደጋው ስጋት መጨመር በግለሰቡ ጾታ እና እድሜ ላይ ይመሰረታል።

English: It is easier for doctors to help people manage this risk if they know how much alcohol people drink.
Luganda: Kyanguyira abasawo okuyamba abantu okukola ku bulabe buno bwe baba bamanyi obungi bw’omwenge omuntu bw’anywa.
Yoruba: Ó rọrùn fún àwọn dókítà láti ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún àwọn ènìyàn láti ṣàmójútó ewu yìí tí wọ́n bá mọ iye ọtí tí àwọn ènìyàn ń mu.
Zulu: Kulula kodokotela ukusiza abantu ukuthi balawule lengozi uma bazi ukuthi abantu baphuza kangakanani utshwala.
Hausa: Yana da sauƙi ga likitoci su taimaka wa mutane su magance wannan haɗari idan sun san yawan barasar da mutane suke sha.
Northern Sotho: Go bonolo go dingaka go thuša batho go laola kotsi ye ge e le gore ba tseba gore batho ba nwa bjala bjo bokaakang.
Amharic: ሰዎች ምን ያህል አልኮል እንደሚጠጡ ካወቁ ለሐኪሞች ሰዎችን ይሄን የአደጋ ስጋት እንዲቆጣጠሩት ለመርዳት ቀላል ነው።

English: The main way researchers get data on how much alcohol people drink is through surveys, especially questionnaires that people fill out themselves.
Luganda: Engeri esinga okuyamba abanoonyereza okufuna obubaka ku ngeri abantu gye banywamu, kwe kuyita mu kunoonyereza, naddala okukozesa enkalala z’ebibuuzo abantu ze bejjuliza bennyini.
Yoruba: Pàtó ọ̀nà tí àwọn aṣèwádìí ti ń rí àwọn dátà lórí iye ìwọ̀n ọtí tí àwọn ènìyàn ń mu nípaṣẹ̀ ìtọpinpin, pàápàá jùlọ àwọn ìbéèrè ìwádìí tí àwọn ènìyàn máa dáhùn fúnra wọn.
Zulu: Indlela eyinhloko abacwaningi abathola ngayo ulwazi lokuthi abantu baphuza utshwala obungakanani ingenhlolovo, ikakhulukazi imibuzo abantu abazigcwalisa yona.
Hausa: Babbar hanyar da masu binciken suke samun bayanai game da yawan barasar da mutane suke sha ita ce ta bincike, musamman tambayoyin da mutane suke cikewa da kansu.
Northern Sotho: Tsela e tee fela yeo banyakišiši ba hwetšago tshedimošo ka yona mabapi le ka fao batho ba nwago bjalo bjo bokaakang ke ka dinyakišišo, kudukudu ka lenaneo la dipotšišonyakišišo tšeo batho ba itlaletšago tšona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ሰዎች ምን ያህል አልኮል እንደሚጠጡ መረጃ የሚያገኙበት ዋናው መንገድ በዳሰሳ ጥናቶች፣ በተለይም ሰዎች እራሳቸውን የሚሞሏቸውን መጠይቆችን በመጠቀም ነው።

English: Unfortunately, people tend to underestimate how much alcohol they drink.
Luganda: Ebembi, abantu batera okuteebereza omwenge mutono ku ogwo gwe banywa.
Yoruba: Ó ṣeni láàánú pé, àwọn ènìyàn ń fojú kéré bí iye ọtí-líle tí wọn ń mu ṣe pọ̀ tó.
Zulu: Ngeshwa, abantu bajwayele ukukubukela phansi ukuthi baphuza kangakanani utshwala.
Hausa: Abin baƙin ciki, mutane sukan raina yawan barasar da suke sha.
Northern Sotho: Ka maswabi, batho ba fela ba nyatša ka fao ba nwago bjala bjo bontši ka gona.
Amharic: እንዳለመታደል ሆኖ፣ ሰዎች የሚጠጡትን የአልኮል መጠን አሳንሶ የማየት አዝማሚያ አላቸው።

English: For example, some studies suggest that people think they drink between 50% and 20% of what they actually drink.
Luganda: Okugeza, okunoonyereza okumu kulaga nti abantu balowoza nti banywa ebintu nga nga 50% ne 20% ku ebyo bye banywera ddala.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí kan sọ pé àwọn ènìyàn rò pé láàrin 50% sí 20% ohun tí wọ́n ń mu gangan ni àwọn ń mu.
Zulu: Isibonelo, ezinye izincwaningo ziphakamisa ukuthi abantu bacabanga ukuthi baphuza phakathi kwama-50% nama-20% walokho abakuphuza ngempela.
Hausa: Alal misali, wasu bincike sun nuna cewa mutane suna tsammanin suna shan barasa a tsakanin kashi 50% zuwa 20% na ainihin abin da suke sha.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, baithuti ba bangwe ba šišinya gore batho ba nagana gore ba nwa magareng ga 50% le 20% ya bjala bjo ba bo nwago.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ አንዳንድ ጥናቶች ሰዎች በትክክለኛው ከሚጠጡት ውስጥ በ50% እና 20% መካከል እንጠጣለን ብለው እንደሚያስቡ ይጠቁማሉ።

English: Thus, researchers wanted to find a way to make accurate predictions of alcohol intake despite this underestimation.
Luganda: Kale nno, abanoonyereza baayagala okuzuula engeri y’okutuuka ku kuteebereza okutuufu okw’omwenge ogunyweebwa wadde nga waliwo okuteebereza okwo okutono.
Yoruba: Nítorí náà, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ wá ọ̀nà láti sọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ ọtí-líle mímu tí ó ṣe rẹ́gí pẹ̀lú gbogbo ìfojúkéré yìí.
Zulu: Ngakho, abacwaningi bafuna ukuthola indlela yokubikezela ngokunembile ukuphuza utshwala naphezu kwalokhu kubukelwa phansi.
Hausa: Don haka, masu binciken sun so su nemo hanyar da za su yi daidaitattun hasashe game da shan barasa duk da wannan rashin fahimta.
Northern Sotho: Se se ra gore, bantyakišiši ba eb ba nyaka go tseba ditsela tša go dira dikakanyo tše di nepagetšego tša go nwa bjala ka ntle le go dikakanyo tše tša fase tša go nwa bjala.
Amharic: ስለሆነም፣ ተመራማሪዎች እንዲህ ዝቅተኛ ግምት ቢኖራቸውም ስለ አልኮል መጠጥ ትክክለኛ ትንበያዎችን ለመስጠት መንገድ ለማግንኘት ፈለጉ።

English: These researchers made a computer model that uses survey and alcohol sales data to predict alcohol intake.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bano baakola omutetenkanyirizo gwa kompyuta ogukozesa okunoonyereza n’omwenge ogutundibwa okuteebereza obungi bw’omwenge ogunywebwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí yìí ṣètò módẹ́ẹ̀lì ẹ̀rọ ayára-bí-àṣá kan tí ó ń lo ìtọpinpin àti àwọn ìtaja ọtí-líle láti sọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ ọtí-líle mímu.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi benze indlela yokusebenza yekhompuyutha esebenzisa inhlolovo nolwazi lokuthengiswa kotshwala ukuze babikezele ukuphuza utshwala.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken sun yi samfurin kwamfuta wanda yake amfani da bayanan nazari da tallace-tallace barasa domin hasashen shan barasa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ba dirile mokgwa wa dikhomphutha wo o šomišago tshedimošo ya  dinyakišišo le dithekišo tša bjala go akanya go nwa bjala.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች አልኮል አወሳሰድን ለመተንበይ የዳሰሳ ጥናት እና የአልኮል ሽያጭ መረጃን የሚጠቀም የኮምፒተር ሞዴል ሠርተዋል።

English: They used data from 17 surveys of South Africans 15 years and older, taken between 1998 and 2016.
Luganda: Baakozesa obubaka okuva mu kunoonyereza 17 mu Banna-South Afirika ab’emyaka 15 n’okusingawo, obwakuŋŋaanyizibwa wakati wa 1998 ne 2016.
Yoruba: Wọ́n lo àwọn dáta láti inú ìtọpinpin 17 ti àwọn ènìyàn ọdún 15 sókè ti orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa, tí wọ́n gbà láàrin ọdún 1998 àti ọdún 2016.
Zulu: Basebenzise imininingwane yocwaningo oluyi-17 lwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka eli-15 nangaphezulu, olwathathwa phakathi kowe-1998 nowezi-2016.
Hausa: Sun yi amfani da bayanai daga bincike guda 17 na ‘yan Afirka ta Kudu masu shekaru 15 da haihuwa, waɗanda aka ɗauka a tsakanin shekarar 1998 da kuma shekarar 2016.
Northern Sotho: Ba šomišitše tshedimošo go tšwa go dinyakišišo ka ga MaAfrtika Borwa a mengwaga ye 17 le go feta, tšeo di dirilwego magareng ga 1998 le 2016.
Amharic: በ1998 እና 2016 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ የተወሰዱ፣ ከ15 ዓመት እና ከዚያ በላይ በሆናቸው ደቡብ አፍሪካውያን የተደረጉ 17 የዳሰሳ ጥናቶችን ተጠቅመዋል።

English: Their model predicted what percentage of people drink alcohol and how much alcohol they drink.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gwabwe gwateebereza obungi bw’abantu abanywa omwenge n’obungi bwe bwanywa.
Yoruba: Módẹ́ẹ̀lì wọn sọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ ìwọ̀n àwọn ènìyàn tí ó ń mu ọtí-líle àti iye ọtí-líle tí wọn ń mu.
Zulu: Indlela yokusebenza yabo yabikezela ukuthi mangaki amaphesenti abantu abaphuza utshwala nokuthi baphuza kangakanani utshwala.
Hausa: Samfurinsu ya yi hasashen kashi nawa na mutane suke shan barasa da kuma yawan barasa da suke sha.
Northern Sotho: Mokgwa wa bona o akantše gore ke persente ye kaakang ya bathoye e nwago bjala le gore ba nwa bjala bjo bokaakang.
Amharic: የእነሱ ሞዴል ምን ያህል ሰዎች አልኮል እንደሚጠጡ እና ምን ያክል መጠን ያለው አልኮል እንደሚጠጡ ተንብዮ ነበር።

English: The model seemed to work well and gave predictions similar to previous studies.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gulabika gwakola bulungi era ne guvaamu ebiteeberezo ebifaanagana n’ebyokunoonyereza okwayita.
Yoruba: Módẹ́èlì náà jọ pé ó ṣiṣẹ́ dáradára tí ó sì sọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ tí ó fi ara pẹ́ ti àwọn ìwádìí àtẹ̀yìnwá.
Zulu: Indlela yokusebenza ibonakala isebenza kahle futhi yanikeza izibikezelo ezifana nezincwaningo zangaphambilini.
Hausa: Samfurin ya yi kama da fi yin aiki da kyau kuma ya bayar da hasashe kamar binciken da suka gabata.
Northern Sotho: Mokgwa wo o bonala o šoma gabotse gomme o file dikakanyo tša go swana le tša dinyakišišo tše di fetilego.
Amharic: ሞዴሉ በደንብ የሚሰራ ይመስላል እና ከቀደምት ጥናቶች ጋር ተመሳሳይ የሆኑ ትንበያዎችን ሰጥቷል።

English: The model predicted that a higher percentage of men drink alcohol than women, and that men drink more alcohol than women.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gwateebereza nti abasajja bangi banywa omwenge okusinga abakazi, era nti abasajja banywa omwenge mungi okusinga abakazi.
Yoruba: Módẹ́ẹ̀lì náà sọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ pé ìwọ̀n iye àwọn ọkùnrin tí ó ń mu ọtí-líle pọ̀ ju àwọn obìnrin lọ, bẹ́ẹ̀ sì ni àwọn ọkùnrin ń mu ọtí-líle ju àwọn obìnrin lọ.
Zulu: Indlela yokusebenza ibikezele ukuthi amaphesenti aphezulu amadoda aphuza utshwala kunabesifazane, nokuthi amadoda aphuza utshwala obuningi kunabesifazane.
Hausa: Samfurin ya yi hasashen cewa kashi mafi girma na maza suna shan barasa fiye da mata, kuma maza suna shan barasa fiye da mata.
Northern Sotho: Mokgwa wo o akantše gore persente ya godingwana ya banna e nwa bjala go feta basadi, le gore banna ba nwa bjala kudu go feta basadi.
Amharic: ሞዴሉ ከሴቶች የበለጠ ወንዶች በከፍተኛ መቶኛ አልኮል እንደሚጠጡ፣ እና ወንዶች ከሴቶች የበለጠ አልኮል እንደሚጠጡ ተንብዮ ነበር።

English: The percentage of men that drink decreased from 56% in 1998 to 51% in 2009, and increased again to 54% in 2016.
Luganda: Omuwendo gw’abasajja abanywa gwakendeera okuva ku 56% mu 1998 okutuuka ku 51% mu 2009, ate ne gweyongera era okutuuka ku 54% mu 2016.
Yoruba: Ìwọ̀n àwọn ọkùnrindínkù láti 56% ní ọdún 1998 sí 51% ní ọdún 2009, ó sì tú lé síi sí 54% ní ọdún 2016.
Zulu: Iphesenti lamadoda aphuzayo lehla lisuka kuma-56% ngowe-1998 laya kuma-51% ngowezi-2009, laphinde lenyuka lafinyelela kuma-54% ngowezi-2016.
Hausa: Yawan mutanen da suke shan barasa ya ragu daga kashi 56% a shekarar 1998 zuwa kashi 51% a shekarar 2009, kuma ya sake ƙaruwa zuwa kashi 54% a shekarar 2016.
Northern Sotho: Persente ya banna yeo e nwago bjala e fokotšegile go tloga go 56% ka 1998 go fihla go 51% ka 2009, gomme ya oketšega gape ka 54% ka 2016.
Amharic: ወንዶች የሚጠጡት በመቶኛ በ1998 ከነበረበት 56% በ2009 ወደ 51% ቀንሷል፣ እና በ2016 እንደገና ወደ 54% ጨምሯል።

English: The percentage of women drinkers increased from 19% to 20%.
Luganda: Omuwendo gw’abakazi abanywi gweyongera okuva ku 19% okutuuka ku 20%.
Yoruba: Ìwọ̀n àwọn obìnrin tí ó ń mu ọtí lé síi láti 19% sí 20%.
Zulu: Amaphesenti abantu besifazane abaphuzayo anyuke esuka kwi-19% aya kuma-20%.
Hausa: Yawan mata mashaya barasa ya ƙaru daga kashi 19% zuwa 20%.
Northern Sotho: Persente ya basadi bao ba nwago bjala e oketšegile go tloga go 19% go fihla go 20%.
Amharic: የሴቶች ጠጪዎች መቶኛ ከ 19% ወደ 20% ጨምሯል።

English: During this same period, the amount that men drink decreased from 52 to 43 grams of pure alcohol per day.
Luganda: Mu kiseera kyekimu kino, obungi abasajja bwe banywa gwakendeera okuva ku gulaamuzi 52 okutuuka ku 43 ez’omwenge gwennyini buli lunaku.
Yoruba: Ní àárín àsìkò yìí kan náà, iye ọtí tí àwọn ọkùnrin ń mu dínkù láti gíráàmù 52 sí 43 ọtí-líle ojú iná lójúmọ́.
Zulu: Phakathi nalesi sikhathi esifanayo, inani eliphuzwa amadoda lehla lisuka kuma-52 laya kuma-43 amagremu otshwala obumsulwa ngosuku.
Hausa: A wannan lokacin, adadin da maza suke sha ya ragu daga gram 52 zuwa 43 na barasa mai tsafta kowace rana.
Northern Sotho: Ka nakong ye, tekano ya banna e fokotšegile go tloga go dikramo tše 52 go ya go tše 43 tša alekhoholo ya thwii ka letšatši.
Amharic: በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ፣ ወንዶች የሚጠጡት መጠን በቀን ከ52 ወደ 43 ግራም ንጹህ አልኮል ቀንሷል።

English: The amount that women drink decreased from 33 to 26 grams per day.
Luganda: Obungi abakazi bwe banywa bakendeera okuva ku gulaamuzi 33 okutuuka ku 26 buli lunaku.
Yoruba: Iye tí àwọn obìnrin ń mu dínkù láti gíráàmù 33 sí 26 lójúmọ́.
Zulu: Inani abesifazane abaphuzayo lehla lisuka kuma-33 laya kuma-26 amagremu ngosuku.
Hausa: Adadin da mata suke sha ya ragu daga gram 33 zuwa 26 a kowace rana.
Northern Sotho: Tekano ya bjala bjo basadi ba bo nwago e fokotšegile go tloga go dikramo tše 33 go fihla go tše 26 ka letšatši.
Amharic: ሴቶች የሚጠጡት መጠን በቀን ከ33 ወደ 26 ግራም ቀንሷል።

English: Some of the largest changes in drinking habits were in young people.
Luganda: Enkyukakyuka ezimu ennene mu mpisa z’okunywa zaali mu bavubuka.
Yoruba: Àyípadà àṣà ọtí mímu yìí tí ó pọ̀jù jẹ́ láàrin àwọn ọ̀dọ́.
Zulu: Ezinye zezinguquko ezinkulu emikhubeni yokuphuza zazisebantwini abasha.
Hausa: Wasu daga cikin manyan canje-canje a cikin halayen shan barasar sun kasance a cikin matasa.
Northern Sotho: Tše dingwe tša diphetošo tše kgolo kudu ka ditlwaeding tša go nwa bjala di bile go bafsa.
Amharic: አንዳንዶቹ የመጠጣት ልምዶች ትልልቅ ለውጦች በወጣት ሰዎች ላይ ነበሩ።

English: The percentage of people aged between 15 and 34 years who drink increased by about 10% from 1998 to 2009.
Luganda: Obungi bw’abantu abalin wakati w’emyaka 15 ne 34 egy’obukulu abanywa gweyongera n’ebitundu nga 10% okuva mu 1998 okutuuka mu 2009.
Yoruba: Ìwọ̀n àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n wà láàrin ọmọ ọdún 15 àti 34 tí wọ́n ń mu àlékún nípa 10% láti ọdún 1998 sí ọdún 2009.
Zulu: Iphesenti labantu abaneminyaka ephakathi kweyi-15 nengama-34 abaphuzayo lenyuke cishe nge-10% kusukela ngowe-1998 kuya kuwezi-2009.
Hausa: Yawan mutanen da suke tsakanin shekaru 15 zuwa 34 da suke sha barasa ya ƙaru da kusan kashi 10% daga shekarar 1998 zuwa shekarar 2009.
Northern Sotho: Persente ya batho ba mengwaga ye 15 le ye 34 bao ba nwago bjala e oketšegile ka tekano ya 10% go tloga ka 1998 go fihla ka 2009.
Amharic: ከ1998 እስከ 2009 ድረስ ከ15 እስከ 34 ዓመት የሆናቸው የሚጠጡ ሰዎች መቶኛ በ10% ገደማ ጨምሯል።

English: Because survey data is often inaccurate, previous studies used global alcohol intake patterns to help make predictions in specific countries.
Luganda: Olw’okuba nti obubaka bw’okunoonyereza oluusi tebuba butuufu ddala, okunoonyereza okwayita kwakozesa okunywa kw’abantu mu nsi yonna okuyambako mu kukola okuteebereza mu mawanga agamu.
Yoruba: Nítorí pé dátà ìtọpinpin kì í sábàá ṣe régí, àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí àtẹ̀yìnwá lo ìlànà ọtí-líle mímu àgbááyé láti ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ àti ṣe àwọn àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè kan pàtó.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi lwenhlolovo ngokuvamile ayinembile, izincwaningo zangaphambilini zasebenzisa amaphethini omhlaba wokuphuza utshwala ukusiza ukubikezela emazweni athile.
Hausa: Domin bayanan binciken sau da yawa ba daidai ba ne, binciken da ya gabata ya yi amfani da tsarin shan barasa na duniya don taimakawa wajen yin hasashe a wasu ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge tshedimošo ya dinyakišišo gantši e nepagetše, dinyakišišo tše di fetilego di šomišitše mekgwa ya go nwa bjala ga batho lefaseng ka bophara go thuša go dira dikakanyo ka dinageng tše itšego.
Amharic: የዳሰሳ ጥናቱ መረጃ ብዙ ጊዜ ትክክል ስላልሆነ፣ ቀደም ያሉ ጥናቶች በተወሰኑ አገሮች ትንበያዎችን ለማድረግ ዓለም አቀፍ የአልኮል አወሳሰድ ዘይቤዎችን ተጠቅመዋል።

English: But, the researchers’ new method of using local alcohol sales will likely give more accurate predictions for South Africa, and potentially other countries.
Luganda: Wabula, akokodyo k’abanoonyereza akapya ak’okukozesa omwenge ogutundibwa mu ggwanga kalabika nga kajja kuvaamu ebiteeberezo ebituufu mu South Afirika, oboolyawo ne mu mawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n, ọ̀nà tuntun àwọn aṣèwádìí nípa lílo ìtajà ọtí-líle yóò fẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́ mú àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ tí ó ṣe rẹ́gí wá fún orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa, àti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn.
Zulu: Kodwa, indlela entsha yabacwaningi yokusebenzisa ukuthengiswa kotshwala basekhaya cishe izonikeza ukuqagela okunembe kakhudlwana kweNingizimu Afrika, kanye namanye amazwe okungenzeka kube khona.
Hausa: Amma, sabuwar hanyar masu binciken ta yin amfani da siyar da barasa na gida za ta iya bayar da ƙarin ingantattun hasashe ga Afirka ta Kudu, da yiwuwar sauran ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Eupša, mokgwa o moswa wa banyakišiši wa go šomiva dithekišo tša bjala ka nageng go na le kgonagalo ya gore di ka fa dikakanyo tše di nepagetšego kudu ka Afrika Borwa, le kgonagalo ya ka dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: ነገር ግን፣ የተመራማሪዎቹ አዲስ የአከባቢ አልኮል ሽያጭን የመጠቀም ዘዴ ለደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ እና ለሌሎች ሀገራት የበለጠ ትክክለኛ ትንበያዎችን ሊሰጥ ይችላል።

English: These new and more precise alcohol intake estimates could enable doctors to manage people’s health better.
Luganda: Okunywa omwenge kuno okuggya okuteeberezebwa kuyinza okuyamba abasawo okukola ku bulamu bw’abantu mu ngeri esingako.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìṣirò ọtí-líle mímu tuntun tí ó sì ṣe déédé díẹ̀ síi wọ̀nyìí lè jẹ́ kí àwọn dókítà lè ṣàmójútó ìlera ènìyàn síi.
Zulu: Lezi zilinganiso ezintsha nezinembe kakhudlwana zokuphuza utshwala zingenza odokotela bakwazi ukuphatha impilo yabantu kangcono.
Hausa: Waɗannan sababbin ƙididdiga masu inganci na shan barasa suna iya bai wa likitoci damar sarrafa lafiyar mutane da kyau.
Northern Sotho: Dikakanyo tše diswa tše le tšeo di nepagetšego kudu di ka kgontšha dingaka go laola maphgelo a batho bokaone.
Amharic: እነዚህ አዲስ እና ትክክለኛ የአልኮል አወሳሰድ ግምቶች ዶክተሮች የሰዎችን ጤና በተሻለ ሁኔታ እንዲቆጣጠሩ ያስችላቸዋል።

English: The researchers want to improve the model by checking some of their assumptions, using more data, and extending the model to predict how illness caused by alcohol affects the economy.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagala okwongera omuwendo ku mutetenkanyirizo nga bakebera ku kunywa kwabwe okumu, nga bakozesa obubaka obusingako, n’okugaziya omutetenkanyirizo okuteebereza engeri obulwadde obuva ku kunywa omwenge gye kukosaamu ebyenfuna.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ láti mú ìdàgbàsókè bá módẹ́ẹ̀lì náà nípa ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò díẹ̀ nínú àwọn èrò inú wọn, lílo àwọn dátà díẹ̀ síi, àti fífẹ́ módẹ́ẹ̀lì lójú láti sọ àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ bí àwọn àìsàn tí ọtí-líle ń fà ṣe ní ipa lórí ọrọ̀-ajé.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bafuna ukuthuthukisa indlela yokusebenza ngokubheka ezinye zemicabango yabo, besebenzisa ulwazi olwengeziwe, futhi banwebe indlela yokusebenza ukuze babikezele ukuthi ukugula okubangelwa utshwala kuwuthinta kanjani umnotho.
Hausa: Masu binciken suna so su inganta samfurin ta hanyar duba wasu hasashe, ta yin amfani da ƙarin bayanai, da kuma ƙaddamar da samfurin don yin hasashen yadda rashin lafiyar da barasa take haifarwa yake tasiri ga tattalin arziki.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba nyaka go kaonafatša mokgwa wo ka go lekola dikakanyo tše dingwe, ba šomiša tshedimošo ye nngwe, le go oketša mokgwa wa go akanya ka fao bowletši bjo bo bakilwego ke bjala bo amago enonomi ka gona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ አንዳንድ ግምቶቻቸውን በመመርመር፣ ተጨማሪ መረጃዎችን በመጠቀም፣ እና ሞዴሉን በአልኮል ምክንያት የሚመጣ በሽታ በኢኮኖሚው ላይ ምን ያህል ተጽዕኖ እንደሚያሳድር እንዲተንበይ በማስፋፋት ሞዴሉን ማሻሻል ይፈልጋሉ።

English: They also suggest that research be done on how to make survey data more accurate.
Luganda: Era bateebereza nti okunoonyereza kukolebwe ku ngeri y’okufuulamu obubaka bw’okunoonyereza okubeera obutuufu ddala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún dábàá pé kí a ṣe ìwádìí lórí bí a ṣe lè mú àwọn dáta ìtọpinpin ṣe rẹ́gí síi.
Zulu: Baphinde baphakamise ukuthi kwenziwe ucwaningo mayelana nendlela yokwenza ulwazi lwenhlolovo inembe kakhudlwana.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun bayar da shawarar cewa a yi bincike a kan yadda za a sa bayanan binciken ya zama daidai.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišinya gape gore dinyakišišo di dirwe mabapi le ka fao tshedimošo ya dinyakišišo e ka nepagalago ka gona.
Amharic: የዳሰሳ መረጃን እንዴት የበለጠ ትክክለኛ ማድረግ በሚቻልበት ላይም ጥናት እንዲደረግ ጠቁመዋል።

English: These South African researchers focused on their own country but the model may work for other countries.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza b’e South Afirika bano beemalira ku ggwanga lyabwe naye omutetenkanyirizo gwabwe guyinza okukolera amawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa wọ̀nyìí fojú sun orílẹ̀-èdè ti wọn ṣùgbọ́n módẹ́ẹ̀lì náà lè ṣiṣẹ́ fún àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika bagxile ngezwe labo kodwa lo mfuziselo ungasebenzela amanye amazwe.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken na Afirka ta Kudu sun mayar da hankali ne a kan ƙasarsu, amma samfurin na iya yin aiki ga wasu ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ka Afrika Borwa ba ile ba nepiša naga ya bonba eupša mokgwa wo o ka šoma le ka dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: እነዚህ የደቡብ አፍሪካ ተመራማሪዎች በራሳቸው አገር ላይ ያተኮሩ ቢሆንም ሞዴሉ ግን ለሌሎች አገሮች ሊሠራ ይችላል።

English: In general, however, they say we need more information on alcohol intake in low- and middle-income countries, many of which are in Africa.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, wabula, bagamba nti twetaaga obubaka obusingako ku kunywa omwenge mu mawanga agakyakula n’agakuzeemu, ate nga mangi ku go gali mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Ní àpapọ̀, síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, wọ́n sọ pé a nílo àlàyé síi lórí ọtí-líle mímu ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ìpawówọlé wọ́n kéré àti àwọn èyí tí ìpawówọlé wọn wà ní ipò àárín, nínú èyí tí púpọ̀ wà ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Ngokujwayelekile, nokho, bathi sidinga ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nokuphuzwa kotshwala emazweni anemali ephansi naphakathi, iningi lawo ase-Afrika.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, duk da haka, sun ce muna buƙatar ƙarin bayani game da shan barasa a ƙasashe masu ƙanana da matsakaitan kuɗin shiga, waɗanda yawancin su suna cikin nahiyar Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, le ge go le bjale, ba bolela gore re hloka tshedimošo ye nngwe ka ga go nwa bjala ka dinageng tša letseno la fase le tša letseno la magareng, tšeo bontši bja tšona di lego ka Afrika.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ፣ ግን፣ ዝቅተኛ- እና መካከለኛ- ገቢ ባላቸው ሀገራት፣ አብዛኞቹ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ያሉ፣ አልኮል መጠጣትን በተመለከተ ተጨማሪ መረጃ እንደሚያስፈልገን ይናገራሉ።
